verdict.rationale: Bruno is an API client, not a gateway, but the docs show limited governance of LLM traffic: on Ultimate, License Administrators can control which providers and models Bruno AI may use and 'how requests are protected' [bruno-docs-60]. Bruno AI can also point at company gateways or proxies through OpenAI-compatible endpoints [bruno-docs-54]. This covers only Bruno's own built-in AI usage; there is no evidence that Bruno proxies arbitrary LLM or MCP traffic. Missing for 10: proxying of general LLM/MCP traffic, token limits, explicit prompt guards, provider routing/failover, MCP traffic governance, and independent corroboration.
